label: sub_017_system_kui_01
text: There’s an ominous black stake driven into\nthe ground...

label: sub_017_system_kui_02
text: Will you pull out the stake?

label: sub_017_system_kui_03
text: When you pulled out the stake, it crumbled\nand vanished!

label: sub_017_system_kui_05
text: You heard a mysterious cry coming from the\nshrine!

label: sub_017_system_release_01
text: A faint sound is coming from within the shrine...

label: sub_017_system_release_05
text: Chi-Yu became sealed in the shrine again!

label: sub_017_system_release_06
text: It seems like the shrine won’t open again for a\nlittle while.

label: sub_017_system_hokora_01
text: Faint writing is carved into the shrine...
